title: Rename respects library profile roots
summary: Rename configured-root authority now includes SourceMovies/SourceTV config fallbacks and enabled LibraryProfiles source/output/promotion roots, so profile-backed library files are not falsely marked as outside configured roots.
reason: Rename preview/apply only considered resolved SourceMovies, resolved SourceTV, and Outsource. Setups that rely on LibraryProfiles or config_data fallbacks could show every otherwise-configured Rename row as outside configured roots.
behavior_before: Profile-backed media paths could be shown as Warning: outside configured roots even when the active backend configuration contained the relevant library profile root.
behavior_after: Rename authority derives media roots from backend-owned resolved/config data, including enabled LibraryProfiles source_path, output_path, and promotion_destination fields, while disabled profiles and client-spoofed root fields remain ignored.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_rename -q passed after moving LibraryProfiles root extraction into the Rename domain.
